items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And with Steve Gadd, also, was wonderful. And I played… No, I can’t say I played much with…

ctx.x: And with Steve Gadd, also, was wonderful. And I played… No, I can’t say I played much with… there’s people like Roy Haynes, Maxwell [inaudible]. No, I really wasn’t with Shearing, you know.
I have a list of some of the drummers that you played with. Dannie Richmond. Of course you mentioned Arthur Taylor earlier.
